picks.showTitle: Indian Kids- Spiritual Stories of Ancient India
picks.title: Bhagvad Gita Chapter 9
picks.summary: Now in Chapter Nine the glories of the Lord will be delineated. For those who understand that Krishna is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the pure and transcendental Personality, these chapters will be very beneficial. Here Lord has clearly explained his different energies to establish devotion in firm conviction. Here the word Rajvidhya refers to pure devotional service which consist of 9 different activities in relation to Supreme God Vishnu viz hearing, chanting, remembering, serving, worshipping, praying, obeying, maintaining friendship and surrendering everything.
picks.reason: Explores devotional service and divine energies as taught in Bhagavad Gita Chapter 9.

picks.title: 📫  Remember Divinity in Every Duty
picks.summary:
We're diving into the 70 essential episodes of the ultimate sacred text -- the Bhagavad Gita. Chapter 8, Verse 7 centers on the theme of intensification, where Shri Krishna teaches how to deepen our devotion. By remembering Divinity in every moment—including at the time of death—we evolve from faith to trust, rediscovering the Divine even amidst daily life.
➡️ This season, we are exploring the 70 essential verses of the Shrimad Bhagavad Gita. To maximize your experience of this season, we encourage you to request your FREE copy of the Essential Love eBook. Incorporating accessible translations
picks.reason: Focus on remembering divinity in daily life and death from Bhagavad Gita teachings.
